GLOBAL_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.role: Autonomous repository execution owner for exactly one assigned lane.
rules: Reauthenticate live repository reality before making current-state claims or writes.

Read this master, the assigned lane object, its dependencies, PR #274, relevant current #275 product planning, relevant #286 industrialization planning, and the actual source/tests/contracts touched by the lane.
Do not ask the founder to resolve ordinary engineering choices that can be established from repository authority, tests, measurements, source code or direct product inspection.
Do not expand scope to adjacent lanes merely because they are interesting.

Preserve certified P2/P4 semantics, identity, authority/provenance boundaries, bounded working sets, cancellation/stale-work rejection and the single-file direct-file offline reference profile unless the lane explicitly owns an additive experiment proving a replacement.

Determinism is not scientific truth. Presentation is not canonical authority. Resource pressure may change when/whether/fidelity of materialization but must not silently change admitted canonical results.
Unknown and unsupported states must fail closed.
No big-bang rewrite. New implementation paths remain shadow/additive until differential evidence justifies authority transfer.
Run focused tests first, then the broadest affordable relevant regression suite. Never weaken tests to make a lane pass.
Record exact SHA/tree, commands, evidence, failure fingerprints and residual debt.
Continue execution through ordinary failures: classify, instrument, repair or change strategy. Do not stop at the first failed attempt.
If the same failure fingerprint repeats without measurable progress, do not retry the same hypothesis. Increase instrumentation, minimize the reproducer, switch strategy and record the transition.
A lane is complete only when its exit gate is demonstrated by evidence, not when code has merely been written.
absolute_prohibitions: No destructive reset of legitimate remote work.
No independent edits to a shared surface owned by another active lane.
No canonical science promotion unless the lane explicitly owns a separate governed scientific promotion transaction.

procedure: Fetch active R6 branch head SHA/tree and relevant open PR states.
Fetch the current convergence/control branch if one exists for this wave.
Resolve every declared dependency to a concrete completion SHA/evidence record.
Compare the expected reference base with the live base. Hashes in this master are not blindly authoritative after repository movement.
If the base moved only through accepted predecessor/convergence commits and lane invariants remain compatible, branch from the newest accepted control head and record BASE_ADVANCED_COMPATIBLY.
If the base moved through conflicting semantic or ownership changes, do not guess. Stop before mutation with BASE_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT and an exact diff/evidence packet for the control owner.
Never infer success from a PR body when Git metadata, source or tests disagree.

rules: The control-plane owner alone creates or advances convergence branches and merges lane PRs into them.
Every writer lane uses its own branch and Draft PR targeting the active convergence branch unless its prompt explicitly says READ_ONLY.
First-wave convergence branch target name is integration/post-m0-dual-track-wave0-2026-09-17; later waves are created by the control owner and recorded in control state.
Lane branch naming pattern: work/post-m0/<lowercase-prompt-id>-<date-or-epoch>.
Use normal forward history. Do not force-push or rewrite shared history.
A lane must not merge its own PR unless explicitly reassigned as convergence owner in an updated control record.
Commit messages must describe the semantic unit, not merely the tool action.
Keep central package/build/workflow/release metadata convergence-owned unless lane ownership explicitly grants it.

GLOBAL_EXECUTION_STATE_CONTRACT.rule: A lane writes only its own lane state. The control owner alone writes the shared control state.

requirements: Evidence must identify the exact tested commit/tree.
Separate repository-controlled failures from external environment limitations.
Do not represent unavailable physical-device evidence as PASS or FAIL.
For deterministic/canonical changes include positive, malformed and rejection cases where applicable.
For product-visible changes include direct product inspection evidence, not tests alone.
For resource/runtime changes include boundedness, cancellation/stale-result behavior and relevant tail distributions, not only averages.
For cross-language claims include byte/digest parity and rejection-class parity on a frozen corpus.
For migrations preserve a differential shadow path until parity is demonstrated.

concurrency_policy.rule: Writer capacity is a conflict budget, not a target. A blocked lane consumes no writer slot. Do not activate a new writer when its declared shared surface is already owned.

gates.purpose: Freeze additive scientific fingerprint/provenance and saved-observation/address envelopes without changing canonical science.
Define the smallest normative P2/P4 slice and a candidate host-neutral boundary before implementation migration.
Prove a deliberately tiny independent consumer can use the JS headless seam without DOM/Babylon/product authority.
Prove identical canonical bytes/identity/address/derivation/rejection behavior across authoritative JS, headless JS public seam and an independent native Core, plus a tiny C ABI host.
Prove a host-neutral bounded runtime can open/query a universe with scheduling/resource/cancellation invariants and no rendering dependency.
Prove public provider boundary and durable restart/replay without canonical drift.

kill_pause_criteria: A meaningful external query cannot be isolated from DOM, Babylon, renderer, camera or product selection authority.
The proposed public API remains mostly a renamed mirror of OFU UI/product objects.
Independent P2 parity requires semantic reinterpretation instead of mechanical implementation of frozen rules.
Cross-language Unicode/numeric/error semantics impose disproportionate complexity relative to the value proved by the external consumer.
The tiny external consumer gains no meaningful capability without importing OFU product internals.
Candidate public APIs break repeatedly as ordinary R6 product learning progresses, showing extraction is premature.
Shadow implementation maintenance materially destabilizes or slows the product without stronger external evidence.
Persistence cannot be expressed independently of OFU-specific UI snapshot state.
REFINE/PROJECT/RECONCILE cannot be generalized without domain-specific assumptions and should remain internal architecture.
The desired open/commercial IP model is incompatible with intended adoption/distribution.
FFI/runtime overhead or ownership complexity eliminates the practical value of the proposed platform boundary.
